subject: Aligning evaluation milestones and contract gating for BiomedAI pilot
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@biomedai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Aligning evaluation milestones and contract gating for BiomedAI pilot

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our call, I put together a short mutual action plan (attached) that maps evaluation milestones to the legal/procurement gating we typically see for pilots. High level proposal: 

- Week 0: POC kickoff (access + sample dataset ingestion)
- Week 1–2: Evaluation (metrics: latency, throughput, sample prompt suite pass rate)
- By end Week 2: Vendor security questionnaire returned + SOC 2 evidence requested
- Week 2–3: Legal review of MSA (we can circulate a draft MSA)
- Week 3: DPA finalization (can run in parallel with MSA review subject to legal comfort)
- Week 4: Order form (pricing & committed capacity) signed -> provisioning

Gating notes: we typically require SOC 2 summary and a signed DPA before giving production provisioning. For a pilot we can propose scoped test accounts earlier if legal signs off on limited data retention and logging. I flagged the key dependencies in the attached matrix (BiomedAI-MAP-v1.2.pdf).

Could you confirm: (1) procurement contact for the vendor questionnaire, (2) an internal target for legal review turnaround, and (3) whether you need us to share an editable MSA draft to speed redlines?

Attachments: BiomedAI-MAP-v1.2.pdf (MAP + milestone calendar), redwood-msadpa-dependency-matrix.xlsx (dependency view)

Thanks — I’ve CC’d Marissa (AE) to coordinate timing and Laura B. from Legal to flag any non-standard gating.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek.k@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@biomedai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>, procurement@biomedai.com
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 13:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning evaluation milestones and contract gating for BiomedAI pilot

Vivek — thanks for this, this is helpful. Couple quick items from procurement & security perspective: 

- Procurement: our vendor onboarding team (procurement@biomedai.com) needs the vendor questionnaire completed. Typical timeline from our side is 5–7 business days once we have the SOC 2 and the vendor Qs returned.
- Security: can you share a SOC 2 Type II summary and the controls for data at rest encryption? We also need confirmation on SSO/SAML and SCIM support for user provisioning during the pilot.

Timeline suggestion: we can compress to a 4-week pilot if Redwood can (a) provide SOC 2 summary now, (b) accept the DPA as a standalone signatory instrument to allow provisioning for pilot data access, and (c) provide a sample MSA with the core clauses we expect for data handling. Otherwise we’ll be looking at ~6 weeks to be safe.

Can you also confirm who at Redwood will own completing the vendor questionnaire (we can send it over today)?

On the MAP itself — we prefer to see explicit success criteria for the evaluation (throughput and false-positive rate thresholds). If you can add one page with pass/fail criteria, that will help our internal stakeholders.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Head of Data Platforms, BiomedAI
laura.chen@biomedai.com | +1 617-555-2043
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@biomedai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Dec 2027 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning evaluation milestones and contract gating for BiomedAI pilot

Laura — I can own the vendor questionnaire and the evaluation acceptance criteria page. I’ll take the MAP and add the throughput/accuracy pass/fail section and return by EOD Thursday.

Quick note from our side on sequencing: Redwood Legal prefers to have an executed MSA before we do broad provisioning, but we can run the DPA finalization in parallel with MSA redlines for speed. Practically this means: 

- I’ll send the completed vendor questionnaire to procurement@biomedai.com when ready (target Thu 9 Dec).
- We can start legal redlines the same day we share an editable MSA; legal has indicated ~5 business days for a first-pass review if no major commercial changes are requested.

I’ve attached the dependency matrix (redwood-msadpa-dependency-matrix.xlsx) which maps who needs to sign what and which items gate provisioning. This should help map to your procurement SLA.

Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.c@redwood.com
Attachment: redwood-msadpa-dependency-matrix.xlsx (version 2027-12-08)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.b@redwood.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@biomedai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.c@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Dec 2027 11:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Aligning evaluation milestones and contract gating for BiomedAI pilot

Laura/Team — adding legal perspective and a proposed gating checklist to keep timelines realistic.

Key legal asks we expect from BiomedAI side (to proceed to provisioning and pilot):
- SOC 2 Type II report (or a recent SOC 2 summary/attestation) — required before production credentials are issued.
- DPA: Redwood can accept an executed DPA that references our standard data processing addendum. We are comfortable executing the DPA while MSA redlines are in flight for a pilot scope, provided the DPA contains the agreed retention and deletion language.
- MSA: please flag any non-standard indemnity/limitation requests up front — major commercial changes will extend review time. Our typical internal turnaround is 3–7 business days once we have a completed questionnaire and the initial redlines.
- KMS/Encryption: confirm whether BiomedAI requires customer-managed keys; if so, we’ll need KMS integration details to scope timeline (this usually adds 2–3 weeks).

I’ve summarized the clause positions in the attached docx (redwood-msadpa-clauses-summary.docx). If BiomedAI is open to signing our standard DPA early, we can target a pilot provisioning window in Week 3 from MSA draft exchange — shorter if SOC 2 summary arrives immediately.

On the question of data residency — you mentioned some EU customers in the long term; for the pilot we’ll stick with our US region unless you need EU-based hosting, which would require separate routing and SLA considerations.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.b@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Aligning evaluation milestones and contract gating for BiomedAI pilot — action list & owners

Thanks team — here’s a distilled action list and target timeline so everyone has clear owners and deadlines. Please reply with confirmations and any conflicts by EOD Monday.

Action owners (RDW = Redwood; BMA = BiomedAI):
- BMA: Send completed vendor questionnaire to Marissa (procurement@biomedai.com -> marissa.c@redwood.com) — target: Tue 2027-12-14 EOD.
- RDW (Marissa): Deliver updated MAP with explicit pass/fail criteria — target: Thu 2027-12-09 (completed).
- RDW (Legal - Laura B): Share MSA editable draft to BiomedAI -> target: Tue 2027-12-14.
- BMA: Provide SOC 2 summary & encryption requirements -> target: Tue 2027-12-14.
- RDW: Execute DPA (if agreed) to allow scoped provisioning for pilot -> target: Fri 2027-12-17.
- RDW: Provision test accounts and sample data environment after DPA executed and SOC 2 summary validated -> target: Mon 2027-12-20.

Deliverables & links:
- MAP (final): BiomedAI-MAP-v1.2.pdf (attached)
- Dependency matrix: redwood-msadpa-dependency-matrix.xlsx (attached)
- Legal clauses summary: redwood-msadpa-clauses-summary.docx (attached)
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/biomedai (HubSpot record RDW-2027-0456)
- Drafting/Signing: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/rdw-2027-0456-msadpa

If BiomedAI confirms the vendor questionnaire and SOC 2 summary can be provided by 12/14, we should be able to hit a pilot provisioning date of 12/20 with DPA in place and MSA redlines in process. If any of the procurement/IT items (KMS or custom EU hosting) are required, please flag now as those add lead time.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Marissa will coordinate the questionnaire. Laura B and I will monitor legal gating.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Sales, Redwood Inference
